user.title: Home Camera
user.description: Adds the Cameras panel to the sidebar, for every user (administrators choose the cameras in its Settings tab), and the home camera cards to your dashboards. The panel starts with every camera found in Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Camera is already set up.

legacy_dashboard_install.title: Home Camera still registered as a Marketplace dashboard entry
legacy_dashboard_install.description:
Home Camera is still registered in the Marketplace as a **Dashboard** repository, as before 4.0. The Marketplace downloads `home_camera.zip` for it, so its installs and updates fail with "The installed content has no home_camera.zip". Uninstalling and installing it again does not help: the entry stays a Dashboard one.

1. In **Settings → Marketplace**, uninstall the Home Camera entry of type **Dashboard** if it is installed.
2. Open **Add from link** and remove `juju35/ha-camera` / `juju35/ha-home-camera-card` under **Added from links**.
3. Add `{url}` again with the type **Integration**, update it from there, then restart Home Assistant.

Your dashboards keep working: the integration serves the same cards.
